title: 3-dimensional Rota Conjecture
statement:
Let $V$ be a vector space over an arbitrary infinite field with $\dim V=n^2$. Suppose $B_1,\ldots,B_n$ are $n$ sets of bases of $V$. For each $i$, choose a linear ordering of $B_i$, writing $B_i=\{b_{ijk}\mid j,k\in[n]\}$. **3-dimensional Rota Conjecture.** The sets

$$
C_j=\{b_{ijk}\mid i,k\in[n]\}\quad (j\in[n]),
$$

and

$$
D_k=\{b_{ijk}\mid i,j\in[n]\}\quad (k\in[n])
$$

are each $n$ sets of bases of $V$. The supplied text gives no resolution.
source_name: Xin Li, Liping Zhang and Hanchen Xia, “Two classes of minimal generic fundamental invariants for tensors”, arXiv:2111.07343 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.07343

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2021).
